title: Special Edition: The Pandemic Reaches the President

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、

sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的现场对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is a special episode of The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日》节目的一期特别报道。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: The disease that has infected millions of Americans and killed more than 200,000 of them has now reached the president.
sentences.zh: 这种已经感染了数百万美国人并夺走超过20万生命的疾病，现在已经传染给了总统。

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleagues, White House correspondents Peter
sentences.zh: 我采访了我的同事，白宫记者彼得·

sentences.en: Baker and Maggie Haberman.
sentences.zh: 贝克和玛吉·哈伯曼。

sentences.en: It's Friday afternoon, October 2nd.
sentences.zh: 现在是10月2日，星期五下午。

sentences.en: Maggie and Peter, thank you for making time for us in the middle of a very big and very fast-moving story.
sentences.zh: 玛吉、彼得，感谢你们在这一重大且进展迅速的新闻事件中抽出时间接受采访。

sentences.en: I should say that it is around four o'clock.
sentences.zh: 我得说现在大约是四点钟。

sentences.en: Things about this story may keep changing throughout the day.
sentences.zh: 关于这件事的情况可能会在全天不断变化。

sentences.en: But at this point, what exactly do we know about the president's health?
sentences.zh: 但就目前而言，我们对总统的健康状况究竟了解多少？

sentences.en: At this point, we know that he is symptomatic.
sentences.zh: 目前我们知道他出现了症状。

sentences.en: We're told that the symptoms are mild.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，症状比较轻微。

sentences.en: One person described them to me as like a cold, including some fatigue that he was exhibiting yesterday.
sentences.zh: 有人向我描述说就像感冒一样，包括他昨天表现出的一些疲劳感。

sentences.en: There had been discussions at the White House very early this morning and then later into the morning
sentences.zh: 白宫今天清晨以及随后上午曾进行过讨论，

sentences.en: about the possibility of the president giving some sense to the public that he's fine and that the government is continuing and that he is leading.
sentences.zh: 讨论总统是否应该向公众传达他身体无恙、政府运作正常且他仍在领导国家的信息。

sentences.en: So far, that has not happened.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，这还没有发生。

sentences.en: He was supposed to get on a call with governors around the country to discuss the coronavirus and vulnerable seniors and treating them.
sentences.zh: 他本应与全国各地的州长通电话，讨论新冠病毒、弱势老年人以及对他们的治疗问题。

sentences.en: And he abruptly was not on that call.
sentences.zh: 但他突然没有参加那次通话。

sentences.en: It was Mike Pence who was.
sentences.zh: 是迈克·彭斯参加的。

sentences.en: But the president asked me to take this call today.
sentences.zh: 但总统让我今天接听这个电话。

sentences.en: There are more questions than answers about how he is right now.
sentences.zh: 关于他现在的状况，疑问多于答案。

sentences.en: But of course, the president is in a vulnerable age bracket.
sentences.zh: 但当然，总统处于易感年龄段。

sentences.en: So this is a serious situation.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个严重的情况。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's very serious.
sentences.zh: 是的，非常严重。

sentences.en: At age 74, he's in the most vulnerable category.
sentences.zh: 74岁，他处于最脆弱的群体中。

sentences.en: Eight out of 10 deaths we've seen in the United States from the coronavirus have been people 65 and older.
sentences.zh: 在美国，我们看到每10例新冠死亡病例中，就有8例是65岁及以上的老人。

sentences.en: And while most people who get it at that age do recover, the risk factors go up if there are what they call comorbidities, comorbidities being things like your weight.
sentences.zh: 虽然大多数这个年龄段的人感染后都能康复，但如果存在所谓的合并症，风险因素就会增加，合并症包括体重等问题。

sentences.en: In this case, the president is classified by his weight officially as obese.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，总统的体重被官方归类为肥胖。

sentences.en: That would be a risk factor for him.
sentences.zh: 这对他是风险因素。

sentences.en: So it's a worrisome thing for anybody.
sentences.zh: 所以这对任何人来说都是令人担忧的事情。

sentences.en: And particularly worrisome, obviously, when the president of the United States has a disease that has been so tormenting for so many people.
sentences.zh: 显然，当美国总统患上这种折磨了这么多人的疾病时，尤其令人担忧。

sentences.en: So let's talk about how we came to know that
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们谈谈我们是如何得知

sentences.en: President Trump had the virus.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统感染了病毒的。

sentences.en: My understanding is that it was a somewhat roundabout process.
sentences.zh: 据我了解，这是一个相当曲折的过程。

sentences.en: So I didn't learn that the president has the coronavirus until very early Friday morning.
sentences.zh: 我直到周五清晨才得知总统感染了新冠病毒。

sentences.zh: 之所以会有关于他是否感染的疑问，是因为他的一位高级顾问，一位

sentences.en: constantly around him, Hope Hicks, tested positive earlier on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 一直在他身边的人，霍普·希克斯，在周四早些时候检测呈阳性。

sentences.zh: 这不是白宫助手

sentences.zh: 想要公开的信息。

sentences.en: They had tried keeping it quiet.
sentences.zh: 他们曾试图保持低调。

sentences.en: To their credit, two reporters at
sentences.zh: 值得称赞的是，《彭博新闻》的两位记者

sentences.en: Bloomberg News broke the story and made it public.
sentences.zh: 打破了这一局面，将其公之于众。

sentences.en: And from there, it became very hard for the White
sentences.zh: 从那时起，白宫就很难

sentences.en: But there are still a lot of unanswered questions, Michael.
sentences.zh: 但迈克尔，仍有很多未解之谜。

sentences.zh: 我们不知道总统是什么时候接受检测的，具体时间，他是否接受了不止一次检测，他是什么时候开始

sentences.en: experiencing symptoMs. Again, a lot of this is still just unknown.
sentences.zh: 出现症状的。再说一次，很多情况仍然未知。

sentences.zh: 那么，关于总统和霍普·希克斯的接触情况，以及在他们两人检测呈阳性之前的情况，我们了解多少？

sentences.en: Well, obviously, this is something people are still trying to research and figure out.
sentences.zh: 嗯，显然，人们仍在努力研究和弄清楚这一点。

sentences.zh: 我们现在了解到，参加周六白宫活动的人中，有许多人的检测结果呈阳性，

sentences.en: So I think a lot of attention right now is being paid to that Saturday event and whether that was sort of a spreader moment for this virus.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为现在人们非常关注那次周六的活动，以及那是否是这种病毒的超级传播时刻。

sentences.en: I think because it was outdoors, people had the assumption that it would be, you know, safer than indoors.

sentences.en: But people, most people there were not wearing masks.
sentences.zh: 但大多数人都没有戴口罩。

sentences.zh: 在很多情况下，他们靠得非常近。

sentences.en: I think some people were seen shaking hands and, you know, getting up close.
sentences.zh: 我想有人看到他们握手，你知道，靠得很近。

sentences.en: Social distancing, of course, has not been a priority for this White House.
sentences.zh: 当然，社交距离从来不是本届白宫的优先事项。

sentences.en: Masks have not only been not a priority, but almost actively discouraged in this White House.
sentences.zh: 口罩不仅不是优先事项，在这个白宫里甚至几乎是被积极抵制的。

sentences.en: And so other than the fact that it was outdoors, this event was sort of a case study and what public health people would tell you not to do.

sentences.en: Michael, initially there was an effort by White House aides to try to avoid confirming it.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，起初白宫助手们试图不予证实。

sentences.en: They were trying to keep from allowing the news to spread.
sentences.zh: 他们试图阻止消息传播。

sentences.en: That became untenable after a very short amount of time.
sentences.zh: 但在很短的时间后，这就变得站不住脚了。

sentences.en: And then started the scramble about what was going on with the president.
sentences.zh: 然后就开始了关于总统状况的混乱应对。

sentences.en: And Peter, you're a student of government.
sentences.zh: 彼得，你是政府研究方面的学生。

sentences.en: Let's walk through all the scenarios that could play out under these pretty extraordinary circumstances a month before the election.
sentences.zh: 让我们来梳理一下，在距离大选仅剩一个月，这种相当特殊的情况下，可能会出现的各种局面。

sentences.en: In the event that the president is just recovering in the coming weeks, what happens?
sentences.zh: 如果总统在未来几周内只是处于康复期，会发生什么？

sentences.en: How would that change how he fulfills his presidential duties?
sentences.zh: 这会如何改变他履行总统职责的方式？

sentences.en: If at all, what happens to the campaign?
sentences.zh: 如果会有改变的话，竞选活动又会怎样？

sentences.en: Well, we're at a really extraordinary time for this to be happening for any president.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对于任何一位总统来说，这都发生在一个非常特殊的时期。

sentences.en: He's 32 days away from an election.
sentences.zh: 距离大选还有32天。

sentences.en: He had a relatively robust schedule of campaign rallies.
sentences.zh: 他原本安排了相当密集的竞选集会日程。

sentences.en: He's already had to cancel his appearance at one in Florida today.
sentences.zh: 他今天已经不得不取消了在佛罗里达州的一场活动。

sentences.en: We have one in Wisconsin tomorrow and another in
sentences.zh: 明天在威斯康星州还有一场，另一场在

sentences.en: Arizona on Monday that he obviously won't be at.
sentences.zh: 周一的亚利桑那州，显然他都无法出席了。

sentences.en: And I think that this just throws a campaign up into the air.
sentences.zh: 我认为这让竞选活动陷入了混乱。

sentences.en: The next debate is October 15th.
sentences.zh: 下一场辩论是在10月15日。

sentences.en: Will he be able to make that or not?
sentences.zh: 他能参加吗？

sentences.en: We don't know.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道。

sentences.en: Assuming he's not terribly sick or recovers fast, you know, he'll still be off the campaign trail for probably a couple of weeks, you would imagine.
sentences.zh: 假设他病情不重或者恢复很快，你知道，你大概会认为他可能还是会缺席竞选活动几周。

sentences.en: I'm not a doctor.
sentences.zh: 我不是医生。

sentences.en: If obviously it's worse than that, he could be off the campaign trail all the way up to the election.
sentences.zh: 如果情况显然比这更糟，他可能会一直缺席竞选活动直到大选。

sentences.en: We've known any number of people who recovered, but still took a long time to get their strength back and get past the after effects.
sentences.zh: 我们认识不少康复的人，但他们仍需要很长时间才能恢复体力并摆脱后遗症。

sentences.en: Now, in terms of his duties, as long as he's able to discharge them, he can do them from the residents.
sentences.zh: 至于他的职责，只要他能履行，他可以在住所办公。

sentences.en: He doesn't have to show up at the Oval Office every day.
sentences.zh: 他不必每天都出现在椭圆形办公室。

sentences.en: There's no requirement.
sentences.zh: 没有这种硬性规定。

sentences.en: If for some reason he gets to the point where he feels like he cannot discharge his duties, then that's where the 25th Amendment comes in.
sentences.zh: 如果出于某种原因，他觉得自己无法履行职责，那么这就涉及到了宪法第25修正案。

sentences.en: Under the 25th Amendment, he can sign a letter to the Speaker of the House and the Senate President pro tem transferring his powers temporarily to the
sentences.zh: 根据第25修正案，他可以签署一封信给众议院议长和参议院临时议长，暂时将权力移交给

sentences.en: Vice President.
sentences.zh: 副总统。

sentences.en: That would last for as long as the President decided it would laSt. Now, that's only happened three times since that amendment was ratified in 1967.
sentences.zh: 这种移交将持续到总统决定结束为止。自1967年该修正案批准以来，这种情况只发生过三次。

sentences.en: Once under Reagan, twice under
sentences.zh: 一次是在里根时期，两次是在

sentences.en: George W.
sentences.zh: 乔治·W·

sentences.en: Bush.
sentences.zh: 布什时期。

sentences.en: All three cases where the President was put under anesthesia for like a colonoscopy, and they, for a couple hours, transferred their powers.
sentences.zh: 这三次都是总统因结肠镜检查等原因接受麻醉，他们将权力移交了几个小时。

sentences.en: We've never had a circumstance like this, where a President was facing an illness of uncertain intensity and duration, where this has been an issue.
sentences.zh: 我们从未遇到过这样的情况：总统面临着强度和持续时间都不确定的疾病，从而引发了这个问题。

sentences.en: So we're not at that stage yet, but that's what would happen if things got bad.
sentences.zh: 所以我们还没到那个阶段，但如果情况恶化，就会发生这种情况。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And so staying just a moment longer in this scenario where the President is sick, but he's recovering, we also have a Supreme Court nomination underway.
sentences.zh: 那么，在总统生病但正在康复的这个假设情境下，我们还有一个正在进行的最高法院大法官提名程序。

sentences.en: What do we know about how this might affect that proceeding, especially given what you have just told us
sentences.zh: 关于这可能会如何影响该程序，我们了解多少？特别是考虑到你刚才告诉我们的

sentences.en: about this Saturday event at the White House that involved key figures involved in that nomination
sentences.zh: 关于周六在白宫举行的活动，涉及了参与该提名确认的关键人物，

sentences.en: confirmation, including Senator Mike Lee, who is on the Judiciary Committee, and of course,
sentences.zh: 包括司法委员会成员迈克·李参议员，当然，

sentences.en: Amy Coney Barrett herself.
sentences.zh: 还有艾米·科尼·巴雷特本人。

sentences.en: Yeah, Amy Coney Barrett herself has been tested, and she is negative.
sentences.zh: 是的，艾米·科尼·巴雷特本人已经接受了检测，结果呈阴性。

sentences.en: We are told there are reports out there that she had previously actually had the coronavirus and recovered, so she would presumably have some immunity.
sentences.zh: 我们被告知有报道称她之前实际上得过新冠并已康复，所以据推测她应该会有一些免疫力。

sentences.en: That's the theory, of course, on these things.
sentences.zh: 当然，这只是这类事情的理论说法。

sentences.en: But she has been meeting with a lot of senators, and I think there's a lot of uncertainty at this point.
sentences.zh: 但她一直在会见许多参议员，我认为目前存在很多不确定性。

sentences.en: The Republicans certainly would like to proceed with the Supreme Court confirmation, regardless of what's happening here.
sentences.zh: 共和党人当然希望继续推进最高法院的确认程序，无论这里发生了什么。

sentences.en: But this will add one more note of uncertainty to an already rushed process that was going to be challenging for Republicans under the best of circumstances.
sentences.zh: 但这将给一个本已仓促的进程增加更多的不确定性，即使在最好的情况下，这对共和党人来说也是充满挑战的。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And let's just quickly tick through other known test results that you two have learned in the past few hours.
sentences.zh: 让我们快速过一遍你们两位在过去几个小时里了解到的其他已知检测结果。

sentences.en: Mike Pence has tested negative?
sentences.zh: 迈克·彭斯的检测结果是阴性？

sentences.en: That's correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Joe Biden has tested negative?
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登的检测结果是阴性？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Is there anybody else whose results have just come in, or we are awaiting?
sentences.zh: 还有其他人刚出结果，或者我们正在等待结果吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, Ronna McDaniel, the Republican National Committee chairwoman, has tested positive.
sentences.zh: 是的，共和党全国委员会主席罗娜·麦克丹尼尔检测呈阳性。

sentences.en: She was last with the president, we understand, last Friday, which would have been the day before this announcement of the Supreme Court nomination.
sentences.zh: 据我们了解，她最后一次与总统在一起是在上周五，也就是宣布最高法院提名人选的前一天。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: But most of the others who have tested themselves, who were close to the president in the last few
sentences.zh: 但大多数其他在过去几天里与总统密切接触并接受了检测的人，

sentences.en: days, have, for the moment at least, tested negative, including the chief of staff, the vice president, the treasury secretary, secretary of state, Jerry Kushner, and Ivanka Trump,
sentences.zh: 至少目前为止检测结果都是阴性，包括幕僚长、副总统、财政部长、国务卿、杰瑞·库什纳和伊万卡·特朗普，

sentences.en: Barron, Trump, have all tested negative so far.
sentences.zh: 巴伦·特朗普，到目前为止检测结果都是阴性。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Okay, so you have taken us through the scenarios if the president is recovering from the virus, and it remains pretty mild.
sentences.zh: 好的，你已经带我们梳理了如果总统从病毒中康复，且病情保持轻微的情况。

sentences.en: And a delicate question, but one that I think is on a lot of people's minds, is if the president
sentences.zh: 还有一个微妙的问题，但我认为很多人都在想，如果总统

sentences.en: were to become very sick, if the president were to succumb to the virus, at this late stage of the campaign, what happens, just logistically?
sentences.zh: 病情变得非常严重，如果总统不幸死于该病毒，在竞选活动的这个后期阶段，从后勤上讲会发生什么？

sentences.en: Hundreds of thousands of Americans have already started casting their ballots, early voting has begun.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的美国人已经开始投票，提前投票已经开始。

sentences.en: What would happen to his nomination?
sentences.zh: 他的提名会怎样？

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a great question, and it's a real unexplored territory.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个很好的问题，也是一个真正未被探索的领域。

sentences.en: We've never experienced this at a presidential level.
sentences.zh: 我们在总统层面从未经历过这种情况。

sentences.en: My understanding is that the Republican National Committee has the power to declare another candidate if they decide they need to do that.
sentences.zh: 据我了解，共和党全国委员会有权在他们认为必要时宣布另一位候选人。

sentences.en: But as you point out, ballots have been printed, and many, many have already been cast, which would then raise all sorts of questions.
sentences.zh: 但正如你所指出的，选票已经印好，而且许多选票已经投出，这会引发各种各样的问题。

sentences.en: And I think that lawyers are probably looking at this even as we speak.
sentences.zh: 我想律师们可能在我们谈话的同时就在研究这个问题。

sentences.en: I think you would presume if, for some reason, the president weren't able to complete the election cycle, that Republicans have almost certainly put in Mike Pence, I would imagine.
sentences.zh: 我想你会推测，如果出于某种原因，总统无法完成选举周期，共和党人几乎肯定会推举迈克·彭斯，我想是这样。

sentences.en: I don't know how that would affect ballots that have already been caSt. If you cast a ballot for Donald Trump and
sentences.zh: 我不知道这会如何影响已经投出的选票。如果你投给了唐纳德·特朗普和

sentences.en: Mike Pence, does that ballot get counted for Pence as a candidate for president, or does it get thrown out?
sentences.zh: 迈克·彭斯，那张选票会被计为彭斯作为总统候选人的选票，还是会被作废？

sentences.en: I don't know the answer to that question right now.
sentences.zh: 我现在不知道这个问题的答案。

sentences.en: And it's a little confusing at this point.
sentences.zh: 目前这有点令人困惑。

sentences.en: We have to hope, obviously, it doesn't come to that.
sentences.zh: 我们当然希望事情不会发展到那一步。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I want to talk to you about the conspiracy theories that have been flying around on both sides.
sentences.zh: 我想和你谈谈双方都在流传的阴谋论。

sentences.en: They started almost immediately early this morning when news broke.
sentences.zh: 今天早上新闻一出，它们几乎立刻就开始了。

sentences.en: Is there anything to say about that?
sentences.zh: 对此有什么可说的吗？

sentences.en: So, look, there has been a pretty persistent buzz on the internet and in my inbox from smart, educated people asking, does he really have the coronavirus?
sentences.zh: 所以，你看，互联网上和我的收件箱里一直有相当持续的议论，来自聪明、受过教育的人，他们问：他真的得了新冠吗？

sentences.en: Could this be some kind of an effort to distract from something else?
sentences.zh: 这会不会是为了转移对其他事情的注意力而做出的某种努力？

sentences.en: Or could he be lying?
sentences.zh: 或者他可能在撒谎？

sentences.en: How do you know he really has it?
sentences.zh: 你怎么知道他真的得了？

sentences.en: I think that this is a reflection, unfortunately, of the disorienting effect that this White House's constant falsehoods and lies has had on the general public.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，我认为这反映了白宫不断的虚假陈述和谎言对公众造成的迷茫影响。

sentences.en: But to be clear, there is absolutely no reason to believe that the White House is in on a giant conspiracy to pretend that the president,
sentences.zh: 但要明确一点，绝对没有理由相信白宫参与了一个巨大的阴谋，来假装总统，

sentences.en: who considers sickness to be a sign of weakness, is sick.
sentences.zh: 那个认为生病是软弱表现的人，生病了。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Maggie, as someone who covers this president, this White House, so closely, what are you thinking at this moment?
sentences.zh: 玛吉，作为一名如此密切报道这位总统和白宫的记者，你此刻在想什么？

sentences.en: I'm thinking that this is an astonishing and yet somewhat predictable end to this year.
sentences.zh: 我在想，这是今年令人震惊却又在某种程度上可以预见的结局。

sentences.en: Predictable how?
sentences.zh: 怎么个可预见法？

sentences.en: Well, look, obviously, I and I think everybody else hopes that the president and the first lady and hope Hicks get better and get better quickly and recover fully.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你看，显然，我和我想其他人一样，希望总统、第一夫人和霍普·希克斯能好起来，尽快康复并完全恢复。

sentences.en: It is awful for anybody to be diagnosed with this virus.
sentences.zh: 任何人被诊断出这种病毒都是可怕的。

sentences.en: But the president has, at almost every turn, played down the threat of the virus.
sentences.zh: 但总统几乎在每一个转折点都淡化了病毒的威胁。

sentences.en: He was doing it as recently as yesterday.
sentences.zh: 就在昨天他还在这样做。

sentences.en: He has made fun of Joe Biden for wearing a mask and taking precautions like laying low.
sentences.zh: 他嘲笑乔·拜登戴口罩并采取低调等预防措施。

sentences.en: And there were people around the president, including, I would say, the campaign manager he demoted, Brad Parscale, who were really concerned he was going to get sick.
sentences.zh: 总统身边的人，包括我可以说被他降职的竞选经理布拉德·帕斯卡尔，都非常担心他会生病。

sentences.en: And that was back in March.
sentences.zh: 那还是在三月份。

sentences.en: And that is what has happened now.
sentences.zh: 而现在发生的就是那样。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And Peter, as someone who covers the presidency as an institution and has for decades, what are you thinking in this moment?
sentences.zh: 彼得，作为一名几十年来一直报道总统这一机构的人，你此刻在想什么？

sentences.en: Well, I'm thinking that we're once again in a position that we haven't seen in modern times.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我在想，我们再次处于一个现代从未见过的境地。

sentences.en: How many instances have we seen in the four years of the Trump presidency where we were confronting something we had never really fully experienced before?
sentences.zh: 在特朗普总统任期的四年里，我们有多少次面对我们从未真正完全经历过的事情？

sentences.en: Here we are again, just 32 days out from an election with a president who has contracted an illness that has killed 200,000 of his fellow
sentences.zh: 我们又一次来到了这里，距离大选仅剩32天，而总统感染了一种已经夺走了20万同胞生命的疾病，

sentences.en: countrymen and a virus that he himself had downplayed, as Maggie just said, so much.
sentences.zh: 正如玛吉刚才所说，这是一种他自己曾极力淡化的病毒。

sentences.en: Just last night, he gave a speech.
sentences.zh: 就在昨晚，他发表了演讲。

sentences.en: It is a profound honor to address the 75th annual Al Smith Dinner.
sentences.zh: 能出席第75届年度阿尔·史密斯晚宴，我深感荣幸。

sentences.en: For generations, this wonderful event has been a revered institution in New York and New York life.
sentences.zh: 几代人以来，这个精彩的活动一直是纽约和纽约生活中受人尊敬的机构。

sentences.en: To the Al Smith Dinner via video.
sentences.zh: 通过视频参加阿尔·史密斯晚宴。

sentences.en: As president, I want to thank the Catholic community for the magnificent generosity you showed in
sentences.zh: 作为总统，我要感谢天主教社区在

sentences.en: America's hour of need.
sentences.zh: 美国危难时刻所展现出的宏大慷慨。

sentences.en: We mourn for all of those who lost a loved one.
sentences.zh: 我们为所有失去亲人的人哀悼。

sentences.en: And in their memory, we will defeat the virus.
sentences.zh: 为了纪念他们，我们将战胜病毒。

sentences.en: Through advances in treatment, we have reduced the fatality rate by 85% since just April.
sentences.zh: 通过治疗方面的进步，自四月以来，我们将死亡率降低了85%。

sentences.en: We are on track to develop and distribute a vaccine before the end of the year and maybe substantially before.
sentences.zh: 我们有望在年底前，甚至可能大大提前，开发并分发疫苗。

sentences.en: In which he said the end of the pandemic is in sight.
sentences.zh: 他在演讲中说疫情的终结就在眼前。

sentences.en: That the end of the pandemic is in sight and next year will be one of the greatest years in the history of our country.
sentences.zh: 疫情的终结就在眼前，明年将是我们国家历史上最伟大的年份之一。

sentences.en: So the idea that now he has caught the virus that he himself spent so much time downplaying is an extraordinary situation.
sentences.zh: 所以，他现在感染了自己花了那么多时间淡化的病毒，这是一种非同寻常的情况。

sentences.en: And it raises all kinds of questions.
sentences.zh: 这引发了各种各样的问题。

sentences.en: And it obviously upends the election campaign that we thought we were covering.
sentences.zh: 这显然颠覆了我们以为我们正在报道的竞选活动。

sentences.en: And it upends the stage of the presidency in a way that we can't fully comprehend at this point or predict.
sentences.zh: 它以一种我们目前无法完全理解或预测的方式颠覆了总统职位的阶段。

sentences.en: Maggie and Peter, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 玛吉，彼得，非常感谢你们。

sentences.en: I know we will be back in touch with you both.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们还会和你们两位联系。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: On Friday afternoon, the Times reported that President Trump was headed to Walter Reed Hospital in Maryland, where he was expected to remain for several days.
sentences.zh: 周五下午，《时报》报道称特朗普总统正前往马里兰州的沃尔特·里德医院，预计将在那里停留几天。

sentences.en: The stay was described by the president's press secretary as being, quote, out of an abundance of caution.
sentences.zh: 总统新闻秘书将这次停留描述为，引用原话，“出于谨慎考虑”。

sentences.en: Earlier in the afternoon, the president's doctor, Sean Connolly, had released a memo saying that the president was fatigued,
sentences.zh: 当天下午早些时候，总统的医生肖恩·康利发布了一份备忘录，称总统感到疲劳，

sentences.en: but in good spirits, and had received a single infusion of an experimental treatment, an antibody cocktail,
sentences.zh: 但精神状态良好，并接受了一次实验性治疗，即抗体鸡尾酒疗法的输注，

sentences.en: and that he was also taking vitamin D, zinc, melatonin, aspirin, and pepcid.
sentences.zh: 他还服用维生素D、锌、褪黑素、阿司匹林和法莫替丁。

sentences.en: House Speaker Nancy Pelosi, who would be third behind Vice President Mike Pence to step in and lead the country in the event it
sentences.zh: 众议院议长南希·佩洛西，如果需要，她将排在副总统迈克·彭斯之后，接手领导国家，

sentences.en: became necessary, has now also tested negative for the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 现在也已检测出新冠病毒阴性。

sentences.en: That's it for now.
sentences.zh: 目前就是这样。

sentences.en: I'm Michael
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·

sentences.en: Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you on Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer,
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，

sentences.en: when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一批自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me,
sentences.zh: 在《地铁》的最新一集中，和我一起，

sentences.en: Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 莎拉·凯尼格，讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在任何你收听播客的地方收听。
